c198399915.notes: Blue enamel numbered-street plate, Kuşadası (Aydın province), frontal. Turkish format: municipality header, mahalle (neighbourhood) name, street number + SOKAK, and 'TN:' = tabela numarası (sign number) 43 with a direction arrow. Glare covers the 'LE' of BELEDİYESİ; 'AYDIN' has dotless capital I as expected, other capitals are dotted İ.
